prompt:
Create a production 2D RPG equipment parts atlas, 1152 x 768 pixels, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of 384 x 384 cells. All parts share crisp, detailed pixel-art rendering, worn dark olive industrial metal, restrained brass fittings, warm top-left light, and the SAME steep overhead orthographic camera as a classic top-down RPG: broad visible top surfaces, shortened front faces, vertical sides, no isometric rotation or perspective convergence. Plain pure white background everywhere outside each part, no floor, shadows on the background, grid, words, labels, people or checkerboard.
TOP LEFT: one compact waist-high diesel fuel pump. Dark olive pedestal, substantial visible top, short black hose loop on its right side and a brass nozzle. Front has a small dark circular recess for a separate pressure gauge, and a bolted closed maintenance panel. Do not draw a needle or dial inside that recess. Single standalone pump body, no rail. Center at cell x=192; base at y=340; body fits x=90..295, y=60..340. This body will be reused without any changes in every game state.
TOP MIDDLE: one detached small round ivory pressure dial with dark brass rim and a single black needle pointing lower-left (zero pressure). Face viewed in the same front-plane orientation as the body's gauge recess. No numerals or lettering. Center at cell x=192,y=192, diameter about 100 pixels.
TOP RIGHT: the EXACT SAME pressure dial, same circular face, rim, scale and orientation. Only its black needle points upper-right (working pressure). Center and diameter identical.
BOTTOM LEFT: one detached low straight dark iron safety rail, two anchored feet and a single horizontal bar. Front-facing, matching overhead camera. It is a rail that stands in front of the pump, not attached to a duplicate pump. Span x=55..329; feet at y=300; top around y=190. No pump, no panel, no extra parts.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: the SAME rail with the same anchored feet and width. The horizontal bar has been visibly buckled downward and forward at its center by an impact. Keep its two feet, material and overall identity. No explosion or debris.
BOTTOM RIGHT: completely empty pure white cell. Five isolated parts total. Never duplicate the pump body in other cells. No text anywhere.
